01 / The challenge

The challenge for removals & storage.

Removal trucks are mobile billboards. A Luton or box body gives you a huge, flat canvas that is parked outside homes for hours, often in front of the neighbours who are moving next.

01

Huge flat panels

Box bodies give you lots of space. The temptation is to fill it.

02

Parked all day

Your truck sits outside a home for hours while the street watches.

03

Home and office

Domestic and commercial moves may need different messages.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Company name, very large
  • Removals, storage, packing
  • Phone number and website
  • Area: local, national or international

Build the layout around the job.

Use the space boldly

One big name and a memorable image beat lots of small text.

Brand the rear shutter

Before you book

Good to know.

Can you wrap a Luton box body?

Yes. Send the body dimensions and photos of the shutter and doors.

Can the cab be different to the box?

Yes. Many firms keep the cab simple and put the big graphics on the box.

Can you do a fleet of trucks?

Yes. Send a vehicle list and we will schedule fitting.
